title: flow29: aggressor-side volume imbalance over the last 1 or 3 M5 candles vs WTI direction over the next 6 candles; issue 310
before_registration: No outcome computed. Before this file: Databento cost quotes, the download of the trade files, a bar build smoke test on three finished months (trade and side counts only), and synthetic self-checks of the statistic (planted continuation, planted reversal, null, roll guard, Holm).
declared: Single-year test: 2025-10-01 .. 2026-10-08, one regime, includes the 2026 escalation period. A PASS needs confirmation on 2024-10 .. 2025-10 before any live use. Gross (trade prices), no costs.

data.source: Databento GLBX.MDP3, schema trades, stype_in continuous, symbol CL.v.0 (volume-ranked front month, follows the liquid contract through rolls)

quote.rule: CL.v.0 if <= $40, else CL.c.0 with the last 5 trading days before expiry excluded; both <= $40, so CL.v.0

data.side: databento_dbn Side enum (installed package stub, links the Databento common-fields doc): 'B' (BID) = buy aggressor in a trade, 'A' (ASK) = sell aggressor in a trade, 'N' (NONE) = no side specified by the source
data.time: ts_event (UTC), floored to the bar start

bars.M5: built from CL trades: open first, high max, low min, close = last trade price; total volume; buy = sum of 'B' sizes, sell = sum of 'A' sizes; 'N' excluded from the imbalance
bars.grid: complete 5-minute grid; a bar without trades has volume 0 and the previous close; a bar is closed when it lies in a run of trade-free bars spanning >= 60 minutes (session breaks, weekends)
bars.contract: each bar carries its instrument id; a bar with trades of two contracts is invalid; every window (imbalance bars and outcome bars) must be open and on one contract, so no move spans a roll
bars.day: trading day key validate.day_of (22:00 UTC rollover)

imbalance: I_k(t) = sum(buy - sell) / sum(buy + sell) over the closed bars t-k+1..t, k in {1, 3}; defined only when those bars are open, on one contract, and buy + sell > 0
event: |I_k(t)| >= the 95th percentile (numpy quantile, linear) of all defined |I_k| values in the previous 20 trading days (strictly earlier days with defined values); bars in the first 20 trading days are skipped; I_k = 0 is never an event. Consecutive event bars all count; the day-block bootstrap handles the clustering.
outcome: move = close[t+6] - close[t] (M5 closes, bars t..t+6 open and on one contract); ties (move = 0) dropped; continuation iff sign(move) = sign(I_k)
baseline: p_up = share of up moves over all bars of the same period with a valid outcome window (after the first 20 trading days, ties dropped); the baseline of an event is p_up for a buy event and 1 - p_up for a sell event

primary.statistic: per k: D_k = mean over events of (continuation - baseline of that event) = P(continue | event) - matched baseline
primary.inference: moving-block day bootstrap (validate.day_boot, block 5 trading days, 1000 reps, seed 29) over all bars of the period, recomputing p_up and the event mean in each replicate; two-sided p = 2 x min(share of replicates <= 0, share >= 0), floor 1/reps; Holm over k = 1 and k = 3 at alpha 0.05
primary.pass_rule: PASS iff for at least one k the Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND |D_k| >= 0.03. D_k > 0 is labelled CONTINUATION, D_k < 0 is labelled REVERSAL; both count as a pass.
primary.variants: none; no other thresholds, horizons or lookbacks enter the verdict

secondary.note: reported only, never decide the verdict
secondary.horizons: N = 3 and 12 M5 bars, same statistic
secondary.M1: the same procedure on M1 bars built from the same trades (k in {1, 3}, N = 6 M1 bars, own trailing 20-day thresholds)
secondary.absorption: event bars where the flow-signed price move over the k imbalance bars (close[t] - close[t-k], bars t-k..t open, one contract) is < 0.25 x ATR(10) (Wilder on the M5 grid, true range reset at a contract change); report P(next 6 bars go against the flow) for absorbed vs pushed events with their matched baselines, and D for absorbed events with a bootstrap CI
secondary.oanda: the same CL event bars and timestamps scored on OANDA WTICO/USD mid (research/history.db view candles, read-only, M1 -> M5 last close), close at bar start t+30 min vs bar start t, aligned by UTC; OANDA up-share baseline over the same bars
secondary.atr_move: mean flow-signed move over 6 bars in ATR(10) units, raw and drift-adjusted (minus the flow sign x mean move/ATR over all bars), split by buy and sell events
secondary.power: minimum detectable difference at 80% power = (2.2414 + 0.8416) x bootstrap SE of D_k (two-sided alpha 0.025, the Holm first step)
secondary.descriptive: events per k and per side, the threshold distribution, the share of events with |I| = 1
